messages:
maya: opened PR #582 — 'consolidate docs preview artifacts + fix basePath' :eyes:
maya: netlify preview is up but several assets are 404ing (images + css) when I view the preview at the provided link
jon: can you drop the preview link?
docs-bot: Preview build started: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1a2b3c4d — logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1a2b3c4d
maya: link: https://deploy-preview-582--redwood-docs.netlify.app/docs/intro
jon: looked — page loads but CSS is missing and console shows 404s for /static/media/*-hash.png
ava: likely basePath or PUBLIC_URL mismatch. Did you change basePath handling in next.config or the docs build script?
maya: I changed docs build to set BASE_PATH at build time; in local preview I see assets under /_next/static/..., but preview tries /static/...
jon: Netlify sometimes caches older artifact folders. Can you try clearing cache and re-triggering? Or run a clean build locally to replicate.
maya: tried locally: 
```
# local preview commands
git checkout pr/582
yarn
yarn docs:clean && yarn docs:build && yarn docs:serve
```
But locally served site looks correct. So something in Netlify env is producing different asset paths (maybe NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH not set).
dena: @maya do we set NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH in Netlify env? I remember we rely on NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH for static assets in production builds.
maya: Netlify env shows NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH is blank on previews. That explains it. I can update the Netlify build plugin to inject BASE_PATH for previews, but that needs a small change.
jon: if it's just env var, quick fix: add a Netlify build environment variable for deploy-preview builds or set a fallback in next.config.js to use process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH || '/'.
ava: fallback sounds safest. Then Netlify previews won't 404 even if env var missing. Can you push a tiny patch?
maya: pushed commit 8f7a2b0 with fallback. Rebuilt preview. docs-bot: Preview build started: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/5f6e7d8c — logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/5f6e7d8c
deploy-bot: Build succeeded with warnings. Assets served from /_next/static/... Warnings: image optimization plugin skipped for remote images.
jon: I see preview now looks identical to local. QA pass?
dena: small nit — the migration guide example still references old SDK import path. I'll add a quick one-line change to the PR so docs match SDK 0.14.
maya: ok please add it. One request: whoever merges, please don't merge during nightly artifacts upload window (02:00-03:00 UTC). It causes a partial artifact mismatch on staging.
ava: noted. I can merge after 03:30 UTC. I'm on call tomorrow morning though; prefer daytime merge. Can we tag PR with 'ready-for-merge' once CI green?
dena: I'll push the import fix in a new commit and label when CI passes.
maya: also request reviewers: @jon and @ava. Need approvals from both because this touches build infra and migration guide.
jon: will review now. :thumbsup:
ava: will do final glance after Dena's commit. Also recommend squash-merge (single commit) to avoid polluting release notes.
docs-bot: CI status: all checks passed ✅ — netlify/preview: success, docs-lint: success, link-checker: success
maya: perfect — tagging 'ready-for-merge'
dena: done — label added and small import fix pushed (commit b3d9c1a)
jon: approved. Left one inline comment about wording but not blocking.
ava: approved. I'll wait 45 minutes then merge (to avoid the nightly artifact window).
maya: thanks everyone. One small merge note for whoever clicks the button: select 'Squash and merge' and use PR title as commit message. :shipit:
ava: merging in ~40m, will post here when done.
docs-bot: reminder: deploy preview persists for 7 days after merge.
ava: merged at 1769991320 — master updated, staging deploy triggered. :tada:
maya: thanks! confirmed staging assets look good.
jon: nice, closing out PR thread.
ava: leaving a short how-to in the PR description for future preview issues (how to reproduce locally & Netlify env tip).
